key_features_and_architecture.testing_attribute_requirement: EVERY interactive button, input, select, link, tab, modal action, and data metric MUST include a strict kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='quote-submit-button', data-testid='product-card-prod-1', data-testid='admin-login-button')

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade, Awwwards-level React application in JavaScript (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Lucide Icons.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll container to give heavy momentum to the industrial layout.
Strictly apply data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for automated testing.
Ensure Turkish language throughout all titles, descriptions, table headers, forms, toasts, and admin panels.
Ensure background navigation is never fully transparent over hero content (use glassmorphism border-slate-800 backdrop-blur-xl).
Provide seed data in localStorage or state for products, quote requests, and contact inquiries so the Admin CMS displays real interactive data immediately upon load.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Layered shadows (ambient + direct), crisp borders (1px border-slate-800), and custom scrollbars.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown menus or unreadable header overlays.
Do NOT use emojis like 🤖 or 💡 as icons — use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Rotate font weights dynamically and keep spacing generous.
Include data-testid on every button, link, form input, category tab, product card, modal, and admin action.
